basis: frozen (AI-reviewed baseline), reviewed by ChatGPT (GPT-6, AI reviewer), as stated in its review relayed by the repository owner on 2026-11-20

requirements.quote: generate intent summary before apply structure review
requirements.reason: Intent summary is ordered before structure, details, and tests.

requirements.quote: ask author to clarify PR intent
requirements.reason: Asks the author and aborts if unconfirmed, so the review does not continue.

requirements.quote: read the PR description and understand the problem being solved.
requirements.reason: Context reading step covers it.

requirements.quote: Does the change follow existing codebase patterns? Are new abstractions justified?
requirements.reason: The structure review step covers both questions.

requirements.quote: check code quality, security, and performance using the references below. Look for N+1 queries, hardcoded secrets, and injection risks.
requirements.reason: Same checks are required.

requirements.quote: check for security issues with the OWASP Top 10 as the baseline.
requirements.reason: A dedicated OWASP step is in the logic.

requirements.quote: Are edge cases covered? Do tests assert behavior rather than implementation?
requirements.reason: The test review step covers both.

requirements.quote: review tests as thoroughly as code
requirements.reason: Stated in the always block.

requirements.quote:
if details_findings include critical issues:
    show details_findings
requirements.reason: Source says to note critical issues immediately once found. Built only shows them after the whole details review is complete, and it ignores critical issues from the structure review.

requirements.quote: acknowledge their reasoning before suggesting any alternative.
requirements.reason: Conditional step runs before the reviews, with the same condition.

requirements.quote: block on style preferences when a linter or formatter is configured
requirements.reason: Never-rule, plus skipping style nitpicks in the details step.

requirements.quote: block on personal preferences or demand perfection
requirements.reason: Never-rule.

requirements.quote: be condescending or rude
requirements.reason: Never-rule.

requirements.quote: block on personal preferences or demand perfection
requirements.reason: Same never-rule covers it.

requirements.quote: review without understanding the why
requirements.reason: Never-rule.

requirements.quote: keep feedback specific and actionable, with code examples
requirements.reason: Always-rule.

requirements.quote: keep feedback specific and actionable, with code examples
requirements.reason: Always-rule requires code examples.

requirements.quote: skip praising good work
requirements.reason: Praise is required by an always-rule and the never-rule forbids skipping it. Also the Positive feedback section.

requirements.quote: order feedback from critical to minor
requirements.reason: Always-rule.

requirements.quote: unless report has the seven sections in order
requirements.reason: The seven sections are listed in the output template and enforced by a check.

requirements.quote: the verdict is exactly one of Approve, Request Changes, or Comment
requirements.reason: Enforced in the logic.

requirements.quote: use only Read, Grep, and Glob tools
requirements.reason: Tool restriction plus never writing files or running commands.

introduced.behavior: Aborts the review with a fixed message if the author does not clarify the intent.
introduced.quote: abort with "PR intent is unclear and the author did not clarify it; no review was performed."

introduced.behavior: Requires confirmation from the author before continuing after the clarification request.
Adds a report correction step that reruns assembly when the report is malformed.
introduced.quote: apply report correction with report as report

introduced.behavior: Fixes the order of the OWASP check, after the details review and before the test review.
introduced.quote: apply OWASP security check with details_findings as security_findings
